meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能直接操作浏览器:创建命名页面、打开网站、点击、填表、截图、抓取网页数据、测试网页。脚本之间页面状态会保留,失败后也能接着调试。
howto.when: 当你要求打开某个网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网站或登录等浏览器操作时,它会接管。默认新开一个 Chromium;也可用扩展模式接管你自己已登录的 Chrome。

say.text: 打开 example.com,告诉我标题和当前地址
say.note: 导航后打印标题与 URL

say.text: 把当前页面截一张整页图存到 tmp
用扩展模式在我的 Chrome 里登录后台看看
say.note: 需先启动转发服务并连接扩展

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a browser: open sites, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape web data, and test pages. Page state persists between scripts, so it can also debug after a failure.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask it to open a URL, click, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, test a site, or log in. It launches a fresh Chromium by default, or can attach to your own Chrome via an extension.

say_en.text: Open example.com and tell me the title and current URL
say_en.note: Prints title and URL after navigation

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot and save it to tmp
Use extension mode to log into my Chrome and check the dashboard
say_en.note: Needs the relay server and extension connected
